output.review_comment: The PR contains multiple red flags: (1) Use of `Fraction` without confirming the import is present - this will cause NameError if not imported; (2) Significant change in tiebreaker logic from preferring higher headcount to lower headcount, with no explanation; (3) Addition of a third tiebreaker criterion without justification; (4) No PR description explaining the changes. While the validation logic appears correct per the docstring, the algorithm changes are unexplained and potentially contradict intended behavior. Please: verify Fraction is imported, explain why the tiebreaker logic changed, add a PR description documenting the fixes, and confirm the changes align with the docstring (which wasn't shown in full).
